description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission reference P2024/2412/S73, dated 04/12/2024. The applicant seeks amendments to the consented layouts to ensure compliance with building regulation requirements and to reduce the extent of the consented basement. Amendments to the consented facades are also proposed to ensure alignment with the drawings submitted under planning application ref:P2025/1765/OUT.
